objective.text: Talk with Sylas beneath the tree
Place the Echo Hollow anywhere you like

steps._note: F8 seq 632 root cause 3 (2026-08-02): this step used to highlight ONLY hud.build_button - the DOOR into the builder - and never the CARD, leaving the player to find the Echo Hollow among ~10 Town cards unaided while the next step highlights its card. It now teaches both, and TutorialFlow rotates the single spotlight across the whole list (Highlight[0] used to be the only one that ever rendered).

objective.text: Place your Lumbermill - it harvests timber for you

steps._note: F8 seq 632 root cause 2 (2026-08-02): this step awaited build.structure_placed:lumberyard while promising 'it harvests timber for you'. The catalog says otherwise - lumberyard is behaviorId GameplayBuilding with storageCapacity 500 / storageResource wood (a STOCKPILE that harvests nothing, and per WO-837 a capacity-cap progression building, never a founding freebie), while collector_lumbermill (displayName 'Lumbermill') is behaviorId ResourceCollector, the card that actually harvests. Both ship in the SAME Town palette (build-categories.json: Resource + Collector, neither in lockedIds), so a player who placed the harvester raised an id the step never awaited and stalled the full 300s. The awaited id, the copy and the highlight now all name the Lumbermill; TutorialFlow.SignalSatisfies additionally accepts the lumberyard/lumbermill equivalence on the LIVE signal path (it was previously applied only in the pre-placement auto-completer), so either placement completes the step.
